nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Tidal and wave energy|Overtopping devices_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What previous work has been conducted on single ogee spillways?
nodes.answer: A multitude of experimental work has been conducted, including high head spillway experiments, theoretical modeling of spillway crests, and measurements of pressure distribution along a single ogee spillway.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Tidal and wave energy|Overtopping devices_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What type of spillway is the focus of the experiments in this study?
nodes.answer: The focus of the experiments is on an ogee-shaped spillway with three outlets.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Tidal and wave energy|Overtopping devices_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How is the discharge over an ogee-crested spillway expressed mathematically?
nodes.answer: The discharge is given by the formula Q=CLH^3/2, where Q is discharge, C is the spillway discharge coefficient, L is the spillway length, and H is the total head over the spillway crest.
